_README: STARTING RANGES, NOT APPROVED VALUES. Every number below is a midpoint
of the range in the approved spec. They exist so the pipeline runs
end-to-end before calibration. Experiment 2's grid search overwrites
the 'ranking' block; Experiment 4 overwrites the 'opportunity' block.
Nothing here is hard-coded in any .py file — ranker.py and
opportunity.py read this file at runtime.

ranking_grid._note: Search space for Experiment 2. Inclusive endpoints.

opportunity._note: Inputs to opportunity_strength (spec 9). Calibrated by Experiment 4.

_note: How much opportunity a given intent can carry at all. Multiplies the
intent_match_score term. general_discussion is capped separately by
GENERAL_DISCUSSION_CEILING so it can never exceed 0.40 overall.

ceilings._note: Hard caps on opportunity_strength regardless of other signals.

_note: Per-source prior. Placeholder values only — these are NOT measured.
Until a real per-source quality study exists, every source shares the
neutral default so this term cannot silently bias the ranking.
